title: Sorting by Size
short: Sort things into big and small.

blocks.html: Big ones here, small ones there! Sorting by size is another way to put things together.

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Which acorns are big? Which are small?

blocks.html: Things the same size can go together.

For the grown-up: Sort shoes, spoons or rocks into a big pile and a small pile. Use the words big, small, bigger and smaller as you go. Stop while it is still fun. Then go and play the real-life version.

items: Try it at home: Sort big and small spoons.
Sort rocks from a walk by size.
Put big toys in one box and small toys in another.
